en: Black‑and‑white postcard view over a small European town surrounded by trees. In the background stands a prominent church with a tall spire and clock tower, overlooking clusters of gabled houses with pitched roofs. The foreground is framed by foliage, giving the impression the photograph was taken from an elevated, wooded vantage point. Printed text at the lower left identifies the place as "Dahlen i. Sa." and a small serial number "N 3147B" appears at the lower right.
